home.description: Ordinary left-sidebar Home overview showing Meetings, Recents, Favorites, Agents, Teamspaces, Private, Notion apps, Library, My Tasks, Marketplace and Help; an already-open page may remain visible alongside.

nodes.title: Home
nodes.notes: Stable overview/landing surface reached from Sidebar navigation.

nodes.title: Title only
nodes.notes: Immediate toggle chip within Search overlay.

nodes.title: Created by
nodes.notes: Opens a people picker with Search people textbox.

nodes.title: In
nodes.notes: Opens Search pages picker for page/location scoping.

Page editor
nodes.notes: Full-page editor opened by sidebar New page → Page; scratch created: Scratch Exploration Page 2026-08-09.

nodes.title: Database editor
nodes.notes: Scratch full-page database editor with data-source chooser and default Table view.

nodes.title: Database view settings
nodes.notes: Configure current database view: view name/icon, layout, properties, filters, sorts, grouping, color, automations, AI Autofill, data sources, and locking.

nodes.title: Database layout
nodes.notes: Table-specific options include vertical lines, page icon, wrapping, and page open mode.

nodes.title: Database property visibility
nodes.notes: Per-view property visibility and ordering; search and Hide all available.

nodes.title: Database view filter
nodes.notes: Property filters or advanced filter; text operators documented in grounding notes.

nodes.title: Sort
nodes.notes: Choose a property first; direction and remove controls then appear.

nodes.title: Group
nodes.notes: Choose Group by property, then text grouping mode; also has sort, Hide empty groups, Show all, and Remove grouping.

nodes.title: Conditional color
nodes.notes: New color setting → property → operator/value. Supports multiple rules and delete; applies immediately.

nodes.title: Database property creation
nodes.notes: New property opens searchable type list; selecting a type immediately creates the property and opens its settings.

nodes.title: Property type
nodes.notes: Also exposes installed integration-specific property types.

nodes.title: Database automations
nodes.notes: Upgrade-gated on current plan; panel exposes Upgrade now.

nodes.title: Database agent setup
nodes.notes: Opened from AI Autofill for a database property; Basic configuration and event triggers. Custom Agent is trial-gated.

nodes.title: Side Peek
nodes.notes: Row-page preview with properties, comments, page Actions, Open in full page, and Switch peek mode.

nodes.title: Actions
nodes.notes: Page-level commands in row preview.

nodes.title: Customize layout
nodes.notes: Database-wide row-page layout editor; Apply to all pages commits layout to the database.

nodes.title: Add page module
nodes.notes: Opens module/property type palette.

nodes.title: Marketplace
nodes.notes: Route /marketplace; tabs Discover, Templates, Agents, Consultants, Connections; header Search, My profile, Purchased.

nodes.title: Marketplace Templates
nodes.notes: Natural-language template search, Work/Life/School categories, use-case filters and template listings.

nodes.title: Marketplace Agents
nodes.notes: Catalog of custom-agent listings; route /marketplace/custom-agents.

nodes.title: Marketplace Consultants
nodes.notes: Service filters, consultant directory, Get matched and Book actions.

nodes.title: Marketplace Connections
nodes.notes: Public integration catalog; distinct from workspace Settings → Connections.

nodes.title: Marketplace Search
nodes.notes: Header search becomes combobox; suggestions/no-results list overlays catalog.

nodes.title: Buyer profile — Services
nodes.notes: Empty services/purchases view; columns Active, Consultant, Start date, End date.

nodes.title: Use-case category filter
nodes.notes: Click a chip to filter listings immediately; combines with title/type filters.

nodes.title: Customize Home sections
nodes.notes: Reached from Home tab context menu. Per-section immediate visibility toggles, then Done.

nodes.title: New agent
nodes.notes: Plan-gated; opens Start free trial / Maybe later prompt.

nodes.title: My Tasks
nodes.notes: Task aggregation reached from Home Notion apps section.

nodes.title: Form question creation
nodes.notes: Add page module opens question type picker; tested Text.

nodes.title: Form Preview
nodes.notes: Opens in Side Peek; respondent-facing fields and Submit.

nodes.title: Database view switcher
nodes.notes: Search existing views; per-view settings; New view; New data source.

nodes.title: New database view
nodes.notes: Layout grid creates selected view immediately.

nodes.title: Dashboard database view
nodes.notes: Created immediately; own v= view ID; shows Settings and upgrade CTA in this workspace.

nodes.title: Board view layout
nodes.notes: Opened from a Board view via Settings → Layout.

nodes.title: Card preview
nodes.notes: Page content uses the first block on the page.

nodes.title: Teamspace settings
nodes.notes: Teamspace-scoped modal; tabs General, Members, Security.

nodes.notes: Menu: Property visibility, Filter, Sort, Group.

nodes.title: Library Private Property Visibility

nodes.title: Add custom MCP server
nodes.notes: URL textbox plus Connect/Cancel; Connect is externally consequential.

nodes.title: AI meeting note editor
nodes.notes: Scratch meeting note created from Home; includes Notes/transcription controls.

nodes.notes: Opens Download Notion app and Learn more; does not expose browser capture settings.

nodes.notes: Locally plays the configured consent message.

nodes.title: Copy consent message
